normal.text: Imagine a world where your favorite video games came on VHS! The nostalgia of loading a game like a classic movie adds a unique twist to gaming culture. Dive into the creative possibilities and what this retro format could mean for gameplay and storytelling. What are your thoughts?

normal.name: Chris Hazeldine
normal.text: Hear about Queen's Domain. Download the demo. "Wow this game looks incredible!" Die to a giant cricket and a flower that shoots lasers in the first dungeon. God, I remember when I was good at video games. Top 10 in Wipeout Fusion time trials. Yoshimitsu main. Trophies. Now, defeated by a cricket.
